subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
text:
U1067/26 NOTAMR U0668/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2608200716 C)2611201200 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
REPUBLIC OF CROATIA AS TO ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR
OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION
AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR
OVERFLY CROATIAN AIRSPACE (ZAGREB FIR), EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, SAR
AND LEASED ACFT ONE-WAY RETURN FLTS WITH PERMISSION OF MINISTRY OF
SEA, TRANSPORT AND INFRASTRUCTURE AND IN CASE OF EMERGENCY LANDING
OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT (NOTAM A2845/26),
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY
CITIZENS OF REPUBLIC OF CROATIA, AND ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR
OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY AUTHORITIES OF REPUBLIC OF
CROATIA ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION WITH EXCEPTION TO ACFT IN EMERGENCY SITUATION,
HUMANITARIAN AND MEDICAL FLTS AS WELL AS CASES WHEN SPECIAL
PERMISSION FOR FLT IS GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE.
